title: Acne Detection Software (AcneDect)
brief_summary: This study is to create a self-learning software that can detect acne lesions. Patients take a picture of their face every single day for 3 months with a secure mobile phone and fill out a pre-designed questionnaire. After 3 months, the mobile will be collected back and the pictures will be evaluated by 3 dermatologists. The software is able to learn from the dermatologists' evaluation and -using machine learning- a mechanism that should be able to automatically detect acne to some extent will be established.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Acne vulgaris

Exclusion Criteria:

* Refusal to participate
study_population: Patients within the consultation service of Dermatologische Klinik, Universitätsspital Basel, that meet the inclusion criteria
